description: Import one explicit absolute regular file ON THE MCP-SERVER HOST as a ready immutable attachment in one call. First save expectedStoreId (from claudexor_store_identity) and idempotencyKey with the exact arguments; another store is refused before the file is touched. After any uncertainty or failure repeat the identical call: a completed import returns its original resource without reading the file again, even if the file has since changed or been deleted. Different arguments under a used key are refused; a new edition of the file needs a new key. Pass resource.resourceId in run/turn attachments. No remote-client path, URL, glob or directory; bytes only, no parsing or OCR.

expectedStoreId.description: Store UUID from the opt-in handshake, saved with the key BEFORE the first import and replayed unchanged; never replaced by the current store. A different store is refused before any effect.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-owned key for this one import. Save it with the exact arguments before calling and repeat both after any uncertainty; a completed import returns its original resource without reading the file again. A new edition of the file needs a new key.

kind.description: Default: image when the effective MIME type starts with image/, otherwise file.

mime.description: Default from the file extension (unknown extensions are application/octet-stream).

name.description: Display name. Default: the file's base name.

path.description: Explicit absolute regular file on the MCP-server host, never the remote client's filesystem.

name: claudexor_upload_import

outputSchema.description: Current state of one keyed import, identical for its first call and every replay.

content.description: Exact bytes a keyed import owns, bound by its first accepted declaration.

sha256.description: Exact digest of the bytes: "sha256:" and 64 lowercase hex digits.

resource.description: The immutable resource, present exactly when state is ready.

kind.description: Kind of attached resource: image input or generic file bytes.

purpose.description: Immutable model-operation purpose; absent means a legacy or ordinary attachment.

sha256.description: Content hash in algo:hex form, e.g. "sha256:abcd...".

state.description: open: send the bound bytes; uploading: a transfer is in flight; ready: resource is published; cancelled: finished without a resource, a new attempt needs a new key.

storeId.description: Durable store that owns this import key and its resource.

uploadId.description: Upload that receives this import's bytes.
